AnalysisRecord.title: AnalysisRecord
AnalysisRecord.description: Stores an AI video analysis chat or query record created by a user for a video or scene.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this analysis.

videoTitle.description: Display name of the analyzed video.

scope.description: Temporal scope of the analysis (full video or bounded scene).

startTimecode.description: Start timecode MM:SS or empty string when scope is full.

endTimecode.description: End timecode MM:SS or empty string when scope is full.

startOffset.description: Gemini start offset string (e.g. 15s) or empty string.

endOffset.description: Gemini end offset string (e.g. 60s) or empty string.

fps.description: Frame sampling density used for the analysis.

prompt.description: User prompt or question sent to the AI.

model.description: Model identifier used for the analysis.

clientCreatedAt.description: ISO date-time string when the analysis was created.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated.

SceneBreakdownRecord.title: SceneBreakdownRecord
SceneBreakdownRecord.description: Stores an AI-generated scene breakdown table for a specific video owned by a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

scenes.description: Bounded list of detected scenes (max 50 scenes).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the breakdown was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the breakdown was last updated.

/analyses/{analysisId}.description: Collection of saved AI video analysis chats/queries per user.

/sceneBreakdowns/{breakdownId}.description: Collection of saved AI scene breakdowns per video and user.
